decisions.briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly-down today (NASDAQ -0.7%, S&P500 -0.1%), a neutral session with no clear risk-on or risk-off signal. Rather than holding all cash idle or forcing buys across the board, we selectively added VRNS, the one name on the list showing full multi-signal confirmation (trend, momentum, and volume all aligned).

market_education.summary_en: Today's session was quiet, with the NASDAQ down about 0.7% and the S&P 500 roughly flat, suggesting investors were in a wait-and-see mode rather than reacting to any single major catalyst. Without a strong directional push, broad indices drifted modestly lower while individual stocks diverged based on their own earnings and technical setups. In this kind of environment, stock-picking based on company-specific momentum tends to matter more than following the overall market trend.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市表現平淡，納指下跌約0.7%，標普500指數大致持平，顯示投資者普遍觀望，未見明顯的單一重大消息主導市場。在缺乏明確方向的情況下，大盤指數溫和下滑，但個股表現因應各自業績及技術走勢而分化。在這種環境下，根據個股動能挑選股票，往往比單純追蹤大盤走勢更為重要。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Signal confirmation means waiting until multiple independent indicators — like trend direction, momentum, price position, and trading volume — all point the same way before acting, instead of reacting to just one. It reduces the chance of chasing a false or short-lived move, especially on days when the overall market isn't giving a clear signal.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 訊號確認是指等待多個獨立指標（例如趨勢方向、動能、價格位置及成交量）同時指向同一方向後才採取行動，而非單憑一個訊號貿然進場。這樣可以減少追逐虛假或短暫波動的風險，尤其是在大市方向不明朗的日子更為重要。
